question: What destructive power is attributed to the practitioner when angered?
premises: The practitioner is described as angry.
The action is the destruction of all.
The triple world with moving and unmoving beings is the object.
inference: When angry, the practitioner may destroy the entire triple world with all moving and unmoving beings.
plain_english: When angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all its moving and unmoving beings.
